summary: Restore Expo IAP iOS autolinking for the paid candidate and remove obsolete iOS location permission descriptions after manual-address selection.
noAssistantImpact: Native package/linker and permission descriptions only. Existing canonical domain commands, assistant tools, membership authority and billing activation flags are unchanged. No location callers are reintroduced.

evidence.result: Expo Apple autolinker before/after: ExpoIapModule absent then present. CocoaPods resolves ExpoIap3.4.13/openiap1.3.15; unsigned Preview simulator build passes with ExpoIap/OpenIAP symbols verified in its debug dylib.
Production Expo introspection verifies com.ewatrade.app, IAP plugin, absent three iOS location usage keys and unchanged Android location blocks. Purchase scope remains false.
